application_text: I came into sales through a customer-support desk, which is where I learned that most people who say no are really saying not yet. Most of my week is cold outreach. I book between fifteen and twenty discovery calls a week from cold lists, and I hand every qualified one to a closer with notes on what the prospect said, what they objected to and what they seemed to want. I keep my own tracking sheet because the CRM never quite matches how I work. I have never run the money conversation myself and I am not trying to; I like the front of the funnel and I am good at it. Available from the first of next month, remote or hybrid.

application_text: Eight years in high-ticket coaching sales, the last three of them fully remote. I take over once a call is booked. I run the closing call and take payment on the call itself, and last year I carried a personal quota of 1.2M with a 31 percent close rate on qualified opportunities. I do not prospect and I am not interested in roles where closers are expected to fill their own calendar; that is a different job. What I bring is the conversation at the end - handling the objection about money, the objection about time, and the one about the spouse. References from two previous programme owners available on request.
